atoms.text: Rhys is a Welsh tour guide. Will you explore Wales with him?

instruction.text: Rhys asks if you know where Wales is. Select the UK map with Wales highlighted.

feedback.correct: This is Wales! Wales is the second-smallest country in the UK and is connected by land to England.

instruction.text: The tour will start and end in Wales’ capital city. Answer Rhys’ question.
instruction.sound: The tour will start and end in Wales’s capital city. Answer Rhys’s question.

atoms.a: “What is the name of Wales’ capital city?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m1GbWls'>What is the name of Wales’s capital city?</voice>

instruction.text: Answer Rhys’ question using the map.
instruction.sound: Answer Rhys’s question using the map.

hint.text: Look at the compass in the top left corner. The letter N means north, and the letter S means south.

atoms.a: “Are we starting our tour from the north or south of Wales?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m1GbWls'>Are we starting our tour from the north or south of wales?</voice>

instruction.text: Rhys wants to know if you recognise the sights of Wales. Select the images of places in Wales.

feedback.wrong: This is the city of Tokyo in Japan. Wales doesn’t have huge cities with skyscrapers.

instruction.text: Rhys wants to show you around both the cities and landscapes of Wales. Drag the images to the correct group.

feedback.finish: Wales has a population of over 3 million people. Most people live in the south.
